health.title: Crop Health
health.subtitle: Leaf photos checked by an on-device disease model. A prediction, never a confirmed diagnosis.
health.scanSubtitle: Photograph one affected leaf in daylight, fill the frame, and keep the background plain.
health.formatsHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to 5 MB
health.latestEmptyHint: Your first check will appear here with its crop, result and model confidence.
health.recentEmpty: No checks in your history yet.
health.notSupportedCrop: The model cannot judge this crop yet.
health.stepUploadBody: One leaf, well lit, in focus. Blurry or dark photos are rejected before prediction.
health.stepModelBody: Tomato, potato, maize and pepper are the best covered. Other crops may come back unsupported.
health.stepReport: Read the result, then the report
health.stepReportBody: The report lists what to inspect in the field and when to call an expert. It cites its sources.
health.notADiagnosis: AI prediction · not a confirmed diagnosis
health.diagnoseSubtitle: Upload one leaf photo and pick the crop you are checking.
health.dropTitle: Drop a leaf photo here, or choose a file
health.dropHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP · one image · up to 5 MB
health.previewAlt: Preview of the leaf photo you selected
health.invalidType: This file type is not supported. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
health.invalidSize: This photo is larger than 5 MB. Take a smaller photo or compress it first.
health.invalidEmpty: This file is empty. Choose another photo.
health.cropHint: Choose the crop the leaf belongs to. Unlisted crops are usually reported as unsupported.
health.linkCropHint: Linking records the check against this crop so you can find it in your history.
health.noSavedCrops: You have no saved crops for this crop type.
health.cropsError: Your saved crops could not be loaded. You can still run the check without linking one.
health.submittingHint: This usually takes a few seconds. Keep this page open.
health.serverRejectedType: The server rejected this file type. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
health.serverRejectedSize: The server rejected this photo as too large. Use a photo under 5 MB.
health.serverUnavailable: The disease model is unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes.
health.checkFailed: The check could not be completed.
health.analysisMissing: This check could not be loaded.
health.reportIntro: A written report built from verified sources. Generate it in English or Hindi; it can be edited into your notes.
health.reportUnavailable: The report could not be generated.
health.reportLanguageMissing: This check has no report in {language} yet.
health.reportFallback: Generated by template · the language model was not available.
health.reportLlm: Written with an AI assistant from verified sources.
health.reportSymptoms: Symptoms to check in the field
health.reportInfoNeeded: Information that would sharpen the diagnosis
health.reportConsult: Have an agriculture expert confirm this before acting on a whole field.
health.topKHint: Probability the model assigned to each class. Lower-ranked classes are usually noise.
health.noImage: The API does not return the original leaf photo, so no image is shown here.
health.healthyPrediction: No disease class above the threshold
health.noPrediction: No class was predicted for this check.
health.statusUncertainTitle: Prediction is below the accept threshold
health.statusUnsupportedTitle: This crop is not supported by the model
health.statusRejectedTitle: Photo quality too low to judge
health.statusErrorTitle: The check could not be completed
health.statusRejectedHint: Retake the photo in daylight, filling the frame with one leaf, and run the check again.
health.statusUnsupportedHint: The model only covers a limited set of crops. Try a supported crop, or ask an expert.
health.statusErrorHint: Try the check again. If it keeps failing, the model may be temporarily unavailable.
health.statusUncertainHint: Treat the top class as a hint only. Take a clearer photo or consult an expert.
health.askAssistant: Ask the assistant about this check
health.historySubtitle: Every leaf check you have run, newest first. The latest 100 are shown.
health.noChecksHint: Scan a leaf to start your crop health record.
health.historyError: Your checks could not be loaded.
health.statusHealthyHint: The model found no disease class above the acceptance threshold. Keep watching the crop.
health.statusDiseaseHint: Confirm the symptom pattern in the field before treating the whole plot.
